East Bay Young Democrats — 2026 Local Candidates Questionnaire. Pulled from the form's own data payload, so wording and options are verbatim.

NO DUE DATE STATED. Contact: info@ebyd.org

EVERYTHING IS PUBLISHED. The form opens with "PLEASE NOTE: Anything submitted here will be published online." That includes the campaign information block — mailing address, phone numbers, treasurer and consultant names — so treat every field as public.

EBYD works to encourage young people in Alameda and West Contra Costa counties to take an active role through activism, policy and politics, and promotes candidates and measures advancing economic, environmental and social justice.

TWO AGE QUESTIONS. Whether the candidate is a Young Democrat aged 13-35, and what percentage of paid campaign staff fall in that range. Neither is stated to gate endorsement, but both are asked directly and answered honestly.

THE BALLOT GRID is one question on the live form covering nine statewide and regional measures, each Support / Oppose / No Position. Split here into one item per measure so each position can be decided and tracked separately. Note the third — public campaign financing in general law cities — sits close to the campaign's own experience of Berkeley's programme.

Research not attached.
